p: of Carmel shall wither: Whatever is fruitful and pleasant in Israel, will shortly perish.

three transgressions of Damascus: He shows first that all the people round about would be destroyed for their manifold sins: which are meant by three and four, which make seven, so that the Israelites would the more deeply consider God's judgments toward them.

threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of: If the Syrians will not be spared for committing this cruelty against one city, it is not possible that Israel would escape punishment, which has committed so many and such grievous sins against God and man.
palaces of Benhadad: The antiquity of their buildings will not avoid my judgments. Read Geneva "Jer 49:27"
Kir: Tiglath Pileser led the Assyrians captive, and brought them to Cyrene, which he here calls Kir.
carried away captive the whole captivity: They united themselves with the Edomites their enemies, who carried them away captive.

brotherly covenant: For Esau (from whom came the Edomites) and Jacob were brothers, therefore they ought to have admonished them by their brotherly friendship, and not to have provoked them to hatred.
for ever: He was a continual enemy to him.

have ripped up the women with: He notes the great cruelty of the Ammonites, that did not spare the women, but most tyrannously tormented them, and yet the Ammonites came from Lot, who was of the household of Abraham.
